fields.System.Title: RET-204 — Record visible condition
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a returns clerk, I want to note the obvious state of goods as they arrive, so that
the inspector knows what to look at and clearly damaged items are flagged immediately.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a return line, then a visible condition can be recorded: sealed, opened,
  • damaged packaging, damaged product, incomplete.
  • - Given clearly damaged goods, then they are routed to a separate quarantine area from
  • sealed returns.
  • - Given a condition note, then it does not replace inspection — it informs it.
  • - Given the arrival record, then it is retained even if the inspector later disagrees.

Traceability
